create_PatchEmbed: create a PatchEmbed module to convert 2D image patches into embedded token sequences
create_PatchEmbed3D: create a PatchEmbed3D module to convert 3D video tubelets into embedded token sequences
build_patch_embedding_forward: build a forward pass through PatchEmbed that projects spatial patches into embedding space
build_3d_patch_embedding_forward: build a forward pass through PatchEmbed3D that projects volumetric tubelets into embedding space
test_PatchEmbed_initialization: test PatchEmbed initialization with configurable patch size, input channels, and embedding dimension
